text:
hana: Quick ask — can we land PR #10422 before the infra deploy-freeze on Wed 09:00 PT? Need a short rebase window and a green CI run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/10422

owen: @hana I can try to shepherd. Heads-up CI has been flaky on integration tests today, saw intermittent failure in prefix cache test :/

mira: which test is flaking? I can take a look later this afternoon.

hana: failing test is `tests/e2e/prefix_cache_test.py` — sometimes times out at the KV restore step. stack snippet below from last run:

```
E   TimeoutError: KV restore timed out after 30s
.../tests/e2e/prefix_cache_test.py:128: TimeoutError
```

owen: thanks. I retriggered the main job: `ci-bot: re-run workflow for PR #10422` — we'll see. If it flakes, may need a short rebase with the latest infra fixes.

ci-bot: build #8421 started for PR #10422 (linux/integration). logs: https://ci.internal/builds/8421

sam: if CI still flakey, can we request an emergency small rebase window tomorrow morning (Tue 07:00 PT)? That avoids the Wed freeze. I'm on call and can help watch the run. :+1:

mira: I can review quickly once the run is green. ping me with @mira and I’ll prioritize.

hana: sounds good. @owen can you coordinate the rebase slot if needed? I'll freeze PR approvals until green then tag for merge.

owen: yep — if it fails again I'll open a short-thread to claim the Tue 07:00 PT slot and post the rebase command to run. Also will note any manual test steps.

ci-bot: build #8421 passed (integration) — all checks green. :white_check_mark:

hana: amazing, thanks y'all. @mira @sam could you give final thumbs by EOD? I'd like to land before Wed freeze if we get approvals. :eyes:

mira: giving a quick pass now, left one tiny comment about a log line. will approve after update.

sam: will do a quick security skim, should be fine.

hana: tag me with :merge_when_ready: after approvals and I'll queue it into the pre-freeze merge batch (we're keeping merges minimal during the freeze window).

deploy-bot: reminder — deploy freeze starts Wed 09:00 PT and ends Thu 06:00 PT. Any merges after Tue 23:00 PT require explicit on-call approval.

owen: noted. If we need the rebase slot tomorrow I'll post exact commands and expected time (~10-15m).

hana: thanks everyone — closing loop here. will post final merge note when approved and queued. :pray:
